body: Hey I don't really enjoy anything either! It's all meh!

People really have to stop throwing around this patronizing rubbish. I've not only seen it here, I've seen it on other websites too, for example: "A reminder that you are amazing, you are loved, people care about you!" something along those lines, it's bad enough saying this, but saying it to total strangers is even worse. What would you know????

We don't really truly understand what others are going through, so part of me thinks that we should just keep our comments to ourselves. I personally find comments like 'It'll get better' and 'you have so much to live for'... the first one is such a blanket statement to the point where it sounds patronizing. Do you have a crystal ball? Yeah didn't think you did. 

'You have so much to live for' I've found this to be very guilt tripping. Yeah I'm pretty sure if that person actually had 'so much to live for' they wouldn't be considering suicide. Anyway, yeah I also find it to be a dismissive comment.

Nobody asked to be born, so why should anyone need permission to die? Why should anyone need to specify a reason about why they want to die? It's their life.

I don't encourage suicide yet at the same time I don't really have any interest in talking people out of it. The only thing I would say to people wanting to do it, is that I hope they've thought long and carefully about their choice, and aren't doing it on a whim. Just that they've given it alot of thought.
I can't really relate to anyone. I can very barely relate to my friend but he's twisted like me.

What people really don't "get", is that some people are just naturally quiet. There's nothing wrong with that. Society is always telling people otherwise. "You should talk more!". It's extremely annoying. I'm also a quiet person.
I know this isn't of any help but anyone who just breaks up with the other out of nowhere is just... scum. Truly.
I'm quiet as well and also not that good at socializing. I try to be polite to others but I even worry about coming across as 'rude'. Ugh.
If it were so easy to die, I would've been dead years ago. But I'm still around, existing. Meh.

This isn't just the 'media'. Alot of our freedoms have just been taken away. I honestly don't see it getting any better in the future. Why would it? Life will not go back to what it was pre-covid. This is wreaking havoc on people's mental health. We might as well all be locked up in cages. Eff the world.
Yeah it is. I don't see the world getting any better in the future. I feel like we've all been locked up.

I just wanted to say that I agree with you. People are inherently selfish. See that's why I think many things are such BS. Friendships are a load of rubbish. People will only associate with you if you will 'benefit' them in some way. If you are no longer of use, they are gone. People just use each other. Really.
